research_question: How do Fidelity and Vanguard compare on fees, minimums, outside funds and index fund costs?

research_brief.purpose: Compare the two brokerages from their own fee pages so readers can match an account to their funds.
research_brief.audience: Long-term investors choosing a brokerage or IRA provider.
research_brief.data_period: Fidelity commissions page and Vanguard fees page fetched November 6 to 9, 2026; fund fact sheets dated September 30, 2026.
research_brief.scope_limitations: Vanguard stock commission and options pricing pages were not captured, so the table defers to its fee schedule. No customer-satisfaction ratings are used.
